description: ATG8 paralog expression in human brain (GTEx) and vertebrate conservation of the LMX1B/LMX1A LIR-like core
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
from collections import Counter
P=pd.read_csv("GTEx_ATG8_brain.csv", index_col=0)
atg8=["MAP1LC3A","MAP1LC3B","MAP1LC3C","GABARAP","GABARAPL1","GABARAPL2"]
regions=["Brain_Substantia_nigra","Brain_Putamen_basal_ganglia","Brain_Caudate_basal_ganglia","Brain_Hypothalamus","Brain_Cortex","Brain_Cerebellum"]
D=P.loc[atg8, regions]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(12,4.6), gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[1.3,1]))
a=axes[0]
w=0.13
for k,reg in enumerate(regions):
    a.bar(np.arange(6)+k*w-2.5*w, D[reg].values, w, label=reg.replace("Brain_",""))
a.set_yscale("log"); a.set_xticks(range(6)); a.set_xticklabels(atg8, rotation=25, ha="right")
a.set_ylabel("GTEx v8 median TPM (log scale)"); a.legend(fontsize=7)
a.set_title("ATG8 paralog expression across human brain regions")
a.axhline(1,color="grey",ls=":")

b=axes[1]
sn=P["Brain_Substantia_nigra"].reindex(atg8+["LMX1B","TH"])
cols=["#2b6cb0"]*6+["#dd6b20","#2f855a"]
b.barh(range(len(sn)), sn.values, color=cols)
b.set_yticks(range(len(sn))); b.set_yticklabels(sn.index); b.invert_yaxis()
b.set_xscale("log"); b.set_xlabel("median TPM, substantia nigra")
for i,v in enumerate(sn.values): b.text(v*1.15, i, f"{v:.2f}", va="center", fontsize=8)
b.set_title("Substantia nigra: MAP1LC3C is effectively absent")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(sn.to_string())
print("\nfold difference GABARAP / MAP1LC3C in SN:", round(sn['GABARAP']/sn['MAP1LC3C'],0))

# ---- conservation figure ----
D2=pd.read_csv("ortholog_motif_windows.csv")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(11,3.8), sharey=True)
for ax,pp in zip(axes,["LMX1B","LMX1A"]):
    sub=D2[D2.para==pp]
    labels=["Theta(0)","X1","X2","Gamma(+3)"]
    bottom=np.zeros(4)
    allaa=sorted({x[i] for x in sub.core for i in range(4)})
    cmap=plt.get_cmap("tab20")
    for n,aa in enumerate(allaa):
        vals=[100*sum(1 for c in sub.core if c[i]==aa)/len(sub) for i in range(4)]
        if max(vals)<4: continue
        ax.bar(labels, vals, bottom=bottom, label=aa, color=cmap(n%20))
        for i,v in enumerate(vals):
            if v>=10: ax.text(i, bottom[i]+v/2, aa, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="w")
        bottom=bottom+np.array(vals)
    ax.set_title(f"{pp} orthologues (n={len(sub)} vertebrate entries)")
    ax.set_ylabel("% of orthologues")
axes[0].text(2,50,"Pro at X2\n94%",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="k")
plt.suptitle("Conservation of the C-terminal LIR-like core: LMX1B fixes Pro at X2, LMX1A does not", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
